en_html: In conclusion M. de Lapradelle said that as the question before the Committee was the creation of a new organism forming a part of the League of Nations, it is only right that the election should be entrusted to the two chief organs of this League. In this way the creation of new privileges would be avoided; it would only acknowledge a superiority already established in the Covenant itself. M. de Lapradelle thought that the Committee would best fulfil the duties which had been entrusted to it by the League of Nations, if it adopted this method.
